frequency_question: What proportion of major executive tariff announcements are fully implemented mechanically within 30 to 45 days of initial announcement?
membership_rule: Members are major trade tariff proclamations or executive orders where a specific implementation date was set between 30 and 45 days post-announcement. Excluded are routine administrative tariff rate quotas or multi-year phased tariff adjustments.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named major executive tariff actions with short runway; 100% of executive actions utilizing direct statutory authorities (like Section 232 or International Emergency Economic Powers Act analogues) physically hit their implementation dates when not enjoined or negotiated away.
known_gaps: Excludes cases where preliminary injunctions halted the process, though purely under the clock/process aperture, the mechanical capability of the executive branch is 100%.
skeleton: Executive actions with immediate unilateral statutory authority bypassing standard notice-and-comment rulemaking procedures.
multiplier: 4 hit cases / 4 total historical comparable expedited executive actions
validity_reason: Valid through the current presidential administration's term, as executive rulemaking speed and statutory utilization depend on presidential authorities.
